deletion.title: Read before deleting your account
deletion.intro: Your account will be deleted after a 3-day (72-hour) waiting period.
deletion.item1: You will be signed out immediately and cannot use the account during the waiting period.
deletion.item2: A successful sign-in before the deadline automatically cancels deletion.
deletion.item3: After deletion, your account, personal data, and community content no longer appear in product searches.
deletion.item4: Deletion is soft deletion; underlying records and backups are not immediately purged.
deletion.item5: Shared-ledger history remains and your identity is shown as a deleted user.
deletion.item6: Your email can create a new account, but it inherits no data; your numeric account ID is never reused.
deletion.acknowledge: I understand the consequences of deleting my account
deletion.codePlaceholder: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your current email
deletion.codeSent: A verification code was sent to your current email
